STAGE 1 — scope scan and design constraint extraction (ideation_2, round_20261031_115851_915)

GOAL: fix the admissible design region before committing to one idea, and avoid the four previously rejected mechanisms.
WHAT I CHECKED: the workspace directory is not readable in this session (read -> permission.rejected; glob on **/*.md returns nothing; no shell). So the only evidence available is the round briefing itself, which I used as the specification of the existing machinery: (a) prior selected mechanisms poincare-frechet-successor-codebook (curved successor-weighted codebook centroids), CURVCTRL-SID (per-RQ-level curvature from hard prefix-transition score), BRad-RQ (transition-context entropy -> per-item Poincare radius), plus probed-but-unselected BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ, TSG-SID, LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, behcone-prefix-rq, succboost-geoshift, MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ, BFRQ-KARCHER-MASS, SUCC-GEO-CBTAB; (b) the round's worked mechanism = a certificate-guarded split/merge that keeps levels 1..L-1 bit-identical and moves on a necessary-but-not-sufficient predicate, which moved ~1/3 of the catalogue and failed on the validation L1 negative hit rate.
OBSERVED / DERIVED CONSTRAINTS: curvature-setting, radius-setting, Frechet-mean codebook updates, per-level curvature feedback, successor-profile smoothing and cone/prefix variants are all occupied. The empty part of the design space is (i) horospherical / Busemann (ideal-boundary) geometry, which none of the listed mechanisms uses, and (ii) a move-acceptance rule whose extra condition is a *distortion budget* derived from the Gromov delta of the frozen geometry rather than a chosen threshold.
REASONING: the round explicitly demands the "additional condition" that separates a helpful move from a merely admissible one, justified from the training split or frozen Stage-2 geometry. A Busemann/horospherical margin with a margin floor of 2*delta_p (delta measured on the frozen Poincare embedding, not chosen) plus a strict-decrease requirement on the total leaf-slot Gromov delta gives exactly such a condition, and it is threshold-free. Choosing this as the single idea (ideation_2 position: horospherical ideal-boundary geometry + delta-certified precision move, deepest level only).
STILL OPEN: writing the full specification, the three switches, the safeguards and the frozen-scale cost; then appending the complete answer as the final record.

STAGE 2 — final answer delivered in the response (full block printed there; record summarised because of the 4000-char cap).

IDEA: HORO-LEAF-CERT. Busemann/horospherical deepest-level SID re-assignment with a Gromov-delta distortion budget.
Switch set: behaviour on/off (xi from successor+predecessor mass vs from frozen level-L centroid e_k), geometry on/off (kappa=-1/sigma^2 vs kappa->0 where b_xi degenerates to a linear projection). One training run, no arm run.
Why it is in scope: behaviour = TRAIN directed transitions -> per-item star N(x); geometry = Busemann b_xi(z)=log((1-|z|^2)/|z-xi|^2) at curvature -1/sigma^2 plus Poincare d_H; coupling = A(x,k)=b_{xi_out(k,-x)}(z_x)+b_{xi_in(k,-x)}(z_x) with xi built from w and delta_p=median Gromov delta of the frozen curved star.
Why it fixes the last round: the extra condition is a UNIQUE Busemann argmax with margin > 2*delta_p (delta measured on the frozen Stage-2 embedding, not chosen) plus a strict decrease of the total leaf-slot Gromov delta; ties now mean "no move", so the rule is precision-first instead of coverage-first. Levels 1..L-1 stay bit-identical, so the validation L1 negative hit rate must be bit-identical and is reported as a bug-check; diagnostics also include moved fraction, per-item deepest-code conditional entropy before/after, rejection-reason counts, and Stage-3 test_recall@10 (>0.065 judgement).
Cost: 0 added FLOPs/step across 72,000 steps (24 x 3000); one post-Stage-2 pass of ~1e8 flops, minutes on CPU; no new parameters; Stage 3 unchanged at 150 epochs.
Open: nothing; answer complete.
